title: Remembering a problem is not resolving it

applicability.game_version: Observed in RimWorld 1.6; revalidate behavior for the current game.
applicability.mods: RimMolt and ordinary gameplay; details can vary by version and other enabled mods.

observed: A recurring mood penalty remained open until it triggered another break.
explanation: A hypothesis: the unresolved control gap and lack of a concrete revisit point prolonged the issue.
recommendation: Record the next action, blocker, alternative and revisit condition; increase attention when symptoms repeat.
exceptions: Some penalties are consciously accepted because remediation costs more than the harm; record that reasoning.
verify: Check whether the issue was resolved, deliberately accepted, or assigned a fresh concrete intervention.
review: Reviewed source account; retain provisional status and avoid universal tactical claims.
